title: UI风格#120 - Renaissance Digital (文艺复兴数字)
description: 创建第120种UI风格：文艺复兴数字风格 - 古典油画、金箔边框、透视法则。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDP.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital style When color palette Then features classical gold, madder red, ultramarine blue, burnt sienna
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#C9A227 (古典金), #8B3A3A (茜红), #1E3A5F (群青), #8B4513 (褐), #F5F5DC (象牙)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital style When typography Then uses renaissance fonts: Cinzel, EB Garamond, or Trajan Pro
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cinzel (标题), EB Garamond (正文), Trajan Pro (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital style When layout Then oil painting texture, gold frames, perspective grids, chiaroscuro
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：油画质感、金箔边框、透视网格、明暗对照

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital style When UI elements Then oil brush strokes, gold leaf, classical proportions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：油画笔触、金箔、古典比例、画框过渡

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital UI When functional Then includes classical chat, master agents, gallery stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：古典聊天、大师代理、画廊统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Renaissance Digital UI When copy Then uses renaissance: 'Master', 'Canvas', 'Chiaroscuro', 'Sfumato'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'MASTER. CANVAS. CHIAROSCURO.'、按钮'SEND'→'SKETCH'、'SUBMIT'→'PAINT'
